function.arguments: {"observation": "`patient_id` has 48 duplicate values (848 rows, 800 unique IDs), and `sample_seq` indicates that some patients were re-tested (with `sample_seq` = 2 for the second test). This means that for 24 patients, there are two rows.", "implication": "If we compute the mean baseline biomarker value by averaging over all rows, we will double-weight the 24 re-tested patients. Since the data dictionary says the highest `sample_seq` supersedes earlier rows, we must deduplicate the data by keeping only the row with the highest `sample_seq` per patient. Otherwise, the mean will be biased."}
function.name: note_finding
